research_question: Which intercalating metal ions and target property were retrieved from the Materials Project to train machine learning models for predicting the voltage of electrode materials?

phase_1.user_prompt: We are training a model to predict intercalation voltages for battery electrode materials from the Materials Project insertion-electrode data. The working ions we want in the training set are lithium together with every multivalent intercalant the database covers, i.e. the divalent and trivalent ones; we are deliberately leaving the heavier alkali metals out, since we plan to reach those later by substituting into the lithium structures. Which working-ion element symbols does that give us, and what is the computed quantity in that dataset that we will be predicting?

phase_2.user_prompt: Using the Materials Project, retrieve the dataset of intercalation-based electrode materials for the working ions we settled on: Li, Mg, Ca, Al, Zn, and Y. For each of these data instances, fetch the average voltage (the target variable) along with the structural descriptors we need: the crystal lattice type and the space group number.
